title: Out-of-bounds write through Swift unsafe buffers or C interop
preconditions: Swift code passes a pointer and length across a C ABI boundary
dangerous_transitions: length/index is not bounded by the actual initialized buffer before unsafe write
C callee writes beyond the count/capacity contract
sink_semantics: UnsafeMutablePointer/UnsafeMutableBufferPointer subscripts, pointer arithmetic, and raw-memory writes
C functions receiving Swift buffer baseAddress/count pairs
counterevidence: Safe high-level Swift collection access retains runtime bounds checks.
The foreign pointer contract and owner lifetime are validated at the boundary.
verification_recipe: Trace count/capacity conversions and pointer arithmetic to the write.
Check lifetime scope and imported C function length contract; use sanitizers where available.
